# `parameter-became-required`

Parameter became required

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `parameter-became-required` (all locations), `query-parameter-became-required`, `header-parameter-became-required`, `cookie-parameter-became-required`. Path parameters use `parameter-became-required`. |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Parameters ([RULES.md section 4](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An optional parameter is now required.

## Why this default

Clients that didn't send it are rejected.

## Example

From test case [`parameter-became-required`](../../test/cases/parameter-became-required/): Optional → required.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        - name: limit
          in: query
+         required: true
          schema:
            type: string
```

Findings:

- `query-parameter-became-required` · error · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  parameter-became-required: error
```

## How to fix

Keep it optional and apply a server-side default.
